mechanism: Furosemide causes hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia which increase risk of cardiac arrhythmias; isocarboxazid (MAOI) can cause hypertension and may potentiate sympathomimetic effects, creating combined cardiac and electrolyte risks.
action: Monitor electrolytes (potassium, magnesium) closely, maintain adequate supplementation, monitor blood pressure and cardiac function regularly, and consider alternative diuretics if possible.
